rv.q: So the phrase 'once-in-a-lifetime opportunity' isn't hyperbole when it comes to Jonathan Kent's thrilling account of this Broadway classic.
Every facet of the character is caught by Imelda Staunton who gives one of the greatest performances I’ve ever seen in musical theatre.
Jonathan Kent's perfectly pitched production is worth the 40-year wait.
Nonetheless, it's superior fare and yet another triumph from Chichester Festival Theatre.
If you have any interest in musical theatre, this Gypsy is the event of the decade.
From the moment the overture strikes up, the footlights swivel into position and the red curtain rises, you’re in musical theatre heaven.
It is a phenomenal performance that redefines an already brilliant show to take it to new heights of entertainment and pathos.
In truth, five stars is nowhere near enough for Staunton’s exquisitely-nuanced performance, from soft and gently persuasive to brutal bully, or this fabulous musical.
This is a great production to bring Gypsy to a new era of theatre lovers.
As showbiz exposes go, · it's a mother of a musical.

cn.t: Critics hail this first West End revival in 40 years as a triumph, with near-universal praise for Imelda Staunton's "outstanding" performance as Momma Rose and Jonathan Kent's "superb" production of the classic musical.
